name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 23 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 23 hours starting 2025-05-13, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.75 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
